cohort: Women delivering at Watford General Hospital between 1995 and 2015
finding: Despite a rising Cesarean section rate, the total postnatal bed use for all delivery modes decreased, suggesting that bed occupancy is not a pressure exacerbated by the rising Cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: The mean length of stay post-Cesarean section declined from 4.2 to 2.4 days, while the Cesarean section rate rose from 14.5% to 30.9%.
